_doc: Jira sends issue events to our endpoint when a 'blocks' link is resolved.
The STAS FastAPI endpoint POST /telemetry/jira/webhook produces to stas.jira.ticket.blocked.
Events: issue_updated (when 'blocks' link is removed = unblocked)
We capture BLOCKS_TICKET_OF when a blocking link is resolved.
blocker_id = assignee of the blocking issue
blocked_id = assignee of the blocked issue
duration_hours = time from link creation to resolution
This file documents the configuration; logic is in
name: stas-jira-block-webhook-bridge
